detailed_descriptions.en: The Monstrous Hunter Expansion adds over 120 new items, skills, encounters , and a new playable hero to The Bazaar: Karnok ! Each expansion brings an entirely new experience to the bazaar. The wandering warrior, Karnok, is a mystery even to himself . Where did he come from? What is the powerful Creature that lurks within him? How can he get rid of it…and does he really want to? Harness the monster within ! Build Rage in the heat of battle and release the Creature to ravage your prey…or attempt to restrain it for strategic advantage. Augment its powers with dozens of new items for furiously strong new builds! Karnok makes camp in the shadowy woodlands of Karst , an eerie realm of deadly beasts and dark mysteries. Meet new friends and foes as he searches for clues to his origins. Gentle merchants take warning…Karnok brings feral ferocity to the Bazaar! Please note : Purchase of Karnok does not include Karnok's unique Board, Stash, or Bank - these are earned through the in-game chest system.
